intro:
I’m Kevwe, a games programmer currently focused on gameplay. Over the past four years, I’ve developed games and technical projects using both Unity and Unreal Engine, alongside standalone C++ projects involving gameplay, physics and graphics programming.
I’m particularly interested in player-facing systems: the mechanics, movement, physics, interface and visual feedback that shape how a game feels to play. Games have created some of my most memorable experiences, and I want to help create that feeling for other players.

development.title: Core Gameplay
development.description: Developing movement, interactions and abilities that shape the player’s moment-to-moment experience.

development.title: Game Physics
development.description: Using collision, forces and constraints to create mechanics that feel responsive and satisfying.

development.title: Player Feedback and UI
development.description: Communicating game state clearly through UI, audio and visual feedback.

development.title: Graphics Programming
development.description: Experimenting with shaders and real-time rendering techniques, particularly lighting, skeletal animation and procedural effects.

working.label: Codebase Awareness
working.value: I follow established conventions and understand the existing architecture before making changes.

working.label: Systems Thinking
working.value: I consider how a feature interacts with surrounding systems and affects the player experience.

working.label: Adaptability
working.value: I’m comfortable learning unfamiliar libraries, engines and frameworks.

working.label: Team Communication
working.value: I can explain technical decisions clearly and compromise when it supports the shared result.

games.title: Hades II
games.note: I like how its progression systems give the player meaningful control over how each run develops, and how it uses RNG to introduce variation.

games.title: Disco Elysium
games.note: Its detailed world-building and branching dialogue make choices feel personal, through the use of lots of small-scale consequences.

games.title: The Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild
games.note: Its restrained guidance makes exploring the world feel self-directed and being curious is well-rewarded.
